title: Public Health (Tobacco and Other Products) Act 2023

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.converter: cth_convert_sym_v15.py (a copy of docx_text() and the volume joining of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py, changed only to map Word symbol characters, including the Wingdings smiley face F04A; kept outside the repository)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word file, C2025C00521, refetched from the Federal Register of Legislation; its sha256 is this deposit's download_sha256 (995f37392daccfd1094ad5e0cad95e64732d89585c5dde03989acbcf0f789bdb)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: In section 73(1), table item 5, column 2 (examples of a non-alphabetical character, numeral or ideograph), the Word file writes the last example as a Wingdings symbol character (w:sym, font Wingdings, char F04A). The workbench converter dropped it, leaving the list ending in a comma. In Wingdings F04A is the smiling face (U+263A); cth_convert_sym_v15.py maps it so.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: 2 characters, nothing else: a space and the smiling face ☺ at the end of section 73(1), table item 5, column 2, line 898, which now reads "!, #, $, two or 2, iii or 3, fifty or L, ☺" (was "... fifty or L,"; the converter had dropped the symbol and stripped the trailing space). Line count (3100) is unchanged; character count 240994 -> 240996.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.checked: the same copy with symbol mapping switched off (--nomap) reproduces the previous deposit byte for byte (sha256 01dd748758bc5e5f64324096067843c0f36a39dea7238afe6da33ec7d1692586); the diff against it is line 898 only
